scope: Quaia v1.0.0 source conventions and release-day notebook
frame_order_evidence: Notebook cells19/21/25/28 bin ra/dec via ang2pix(lonlat=True), default RING; cells31..39 read selection maps and plot coord=['C','G']; maps.py lines20..40 match.
coordinate_frame: ICRS/equatorial producer convention; FITS lacks COORDSYS
selection_meaning: Relative propensity; never absolute inclusion probability or inverse probability weight
paper_inconsistency: arXiv2306.17749v2 Eq in III.1 gives1mas/yr atG18.25; adjacent prose gives2.5; executable agrees with equation.

template_definitions.dust: CSFD A_V with R3.1 and0.86 EBV rescaling, high-resolution sampling/downsampling
template_definitions.m10: DR3SelectionFunctionTCG m10 map, degraded NESTED to RING
template_definitions.mcs: Gaia-star density minus Galactic-longitude-reflected density within LMC9deg/SMC5deg
template_definitions.unwisescan: mean nmW1 for Prim=1 unWISE rows
template_definitions.mcsunwise: reflected unWISE count difference within same LMC/SMC discs

exact_generation_limit: Release-day code/notebook qualify convention; Zenodo does not embed producer commit/run receipt, so byte-exact regeneration from this commit is not proved.
